name: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
description: Merlin, the immortal son of the bard Taliesin and Atlantean Princess Charis, is followed through his tragic upbringing, descent into madness, and shocking disappearance, leading to the legend that surrounds him. Set before King Arthur's birth, Merlin, assumed dead or a myth, reemerges in sub-Roman Britain to unite the fractured kingdoms under threat from Saxon invaders.

videos.title: Production Diary 1: The Start of an Epic Adventure
videos.overview: Behind the scenes of week 1 of production on The Pendragon Cycle. Get a glimpse into the rigorous training, stunts, and more during the filming in Hungary.

videos.title: Production Diary 2: The Week of Battles
videos.overview: Behind the scenes of week 2 of production on The Pendragon Cycle. Immerse yourself in the epic battle scenes filled with blood, iron, mayhem and more.

videos.title: Production Diary 3: Meet the Show’s Villain
videos.overview: Behind the scenes during week 3 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Meet Morgian, Charis' intriguing step-sister, and see the first scenes filmed at the home of the Atlanteans.

videos.title: Production Diary 4: A Love Story
videos.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 4 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Embark on a journey alongside the cast and crew as they utilize a Hungarian forest for the mesmerizing backdrop of Myrddin and Ganieda’s meeting and more.

videos.title: Production Diary 5: The Most Stunning Set Yet
videos.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 5 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Set out on an adventure with the cast and crew as they journey to northern Italy to film among the stunning mountaintops.

videos.title: Production Diary 6: The Otherworldly Atlanteans
videos.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 6 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Behold lost Atlantis and the Palace of the Fisher King, and witness Myrddin’s Wrath in the forest of Celyddon.

videos.title: Production Diary 7: Recreating Wales in Italy
videos.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 7 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Join the cast and crew as they face the challenges and triumphs of filming amidst hurricane winds, harsh weather, and the stunning landscapes of Italy.

videos.title: Production Diary 8: Everyone Told Us We Couldn’t Do This
videos.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 8 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Watch as the cast and crew bring an epic, yet dangerous bull-leaping sequence from the book to life in one of the most challenging filming weeks yet.

videos.title: Production Diary 8: Jeremy Boreing AAL

Then follow the Hungarian cast and crew to get a peek at building the foundational friendships in the show.

videos.title: Island of the Mighty
videos.overview: The age of gods is dying, and the tribes of Britain descend into chaos. One man hears a voice that will change history.

videos.title: The Vision of Taliesin
videos.overview: A forbidden union gives birth to a prophecy that will outlive the world that made it.

videos.title: A Fatherless Child
videos.overview: A king demands blood; revelation follows. The old world begins to fall.

videos.title: The King of Maridunum
videos.overview: As Britain bleeds, Merlin must forge unity from chaos—while darkness moves behind kings and blades.

videos.title: The Price of Failure
videos.overview: War brews, loyalties splinter, and Merlin's past erupts—threatening to destroy the fragile future he fights for.

videos.title: Ganieda
videos.overview: After years in exile, Merlin returns to a divided kingdom and meets the woman who will test his destiny.

videos.title: The Last True Bard
videos.overview: Britain gathers for war. Merlin rises from shadow to crown the one king who can unite them all.
